name: Retail windows (festival window editor card + windows table with Confirm/Edit)
notes: Interaction targets: r{n}-confirm (Confirm flips r{n}-status pill amber to green; confirmed state shows row 1 flipped, Confirm button gone), r{n}-edit (loads row into form: editing state), f-key/f-year/f-kind/f-region/f-leadin/f-starts/f-ends/f-notes inputs (-input suffix = the box), f-save, row-{n}. Data via data/<region>/windows.json (gen_windows.py) and scripts/la-pages-windows.mjs. Not in reference: confirmed/editing/empty look (inferred).
